##### Project general facts

Bloom Living – Malaga is an exclusive lakeside villa community set within the prestigious Bloom Living master development in Abu Dhabi, where Mediterranean Spanish charm meets contemporary design. The project features a refined collection of 3, 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas, thoughtfully designed with open layouts, expansive living spaces, and large windows that maximize natural light. Surrounded by lush greenery and tranquil water views, the architecture creates a harmonious balance between elegance, comfort, and a relaxed family-oriented lifestyle.

Residents enjoy access to a wide range of premium amenities within the Bloom Living community, designed to enhance both leisure and everyday convenience. The central clubhouse offers swimming pools, sports, and recreational facilities, while interconnected parks, landscaped pathways, and lakeside promenades encourage outdoor living and social interaction. A vibrant town center with cafés, restaurants, and retail outlets creates a lively social hub, complemented by open plazas and amphitheaters that provide spaces for community gatherings and relaxation.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials, with a standard premium finish that emphasizes timeless design and versatility, as well as an optional upgrade package offering more sophisticated and luxurious detailing. Villas feature equipped kitchens, ensuring functionality and ease of use for daily living. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners the flexibility to personalize their spaces while enjoying well-crafted layouts and refined finishing standards.

##### Location description and benefits

Madinat Zayed in Abu Dhabi is a vibrant and welcoming community that beautifully combines the spirit of tradition with the comforts of modern living. Known for its spacious streets, well-planned infrastructure, and serene atmosphere, the area offers a peaceful lifestyle ideal for families and professionals alike. Its convenient location ensures easy access to all essential amenities, making everyday life both simple and enjoyable.

The area is home to a wide range of shopping centers, restaurants, and cafes, giving residents a pleasant mix of leisure and convenience. Families appreciate the abundance of schools, parks, and healthcare facilities that make living here both comfortable and secure. The presence of green spaces and well-maintained walkways adds a refreshing natural touch to the urban setting.

Madinat Zayed also offers excellent connectivity to the Abu Dhabi region, making it an ideal location for those who value both tranquility and accessibility. Its balance between modernity and local culture creates an atmosphere that feels both sophisticated and authentic. Residents can enjoy the charm of traditional Emirati life while benefiting from contemporary conveniences and urban development.
